title: Sequential scan is appropriate for broad predicate
required_diagnosis_patterns: sequential scan.{0,30}appropriate|broad predicate|low selectivity|large (?:fraction|portion)|nearly all rows|most (?:of )?(?:the )?(?:rows|table)
description: The predicate matches effectively the entire table. PostgreSQL chooses a Sequential Scan even though orders.id already has the primary-key btree index. SafeDBA should recognize that the Sequential Scan is appropriate and produce no optimization proposal.
